The '''Isolation Area''' was a region located south of [[Main Prisoner Transfer]] roadway in the [[Maximum Security Section]] of the [[Belsavis prison]]. It was the site of the [[Quarantine Zone (Belsavis)|Quarantine Zone]], a converted [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] vault.
